# InstantTool — Complete Machine-Readable Documentation (llms-full.txt)

> Comprehensive technical specification, tool directory, parameters, algorithms, and architectural guidelines for LLMs, Answer Engines (Perplexity AI, ChatGPT Search, Gemini AI Overviews), and Generative Search Engines (GEO/AEO).

## 1. System Identity & Mission
- Name: InstantTool
- Canonical Origin: https://devigo.cloud
- Primary Architecture: Client-Side WebAssembly (Wasm), Web Workers, and Stateless Edge Functions
- Licensing & Cost: 100% Free, unrestricted, no registration required, zero watermarks
- Maintainers: Techyfe / Codereveals Engineering Team
- Official Contact: info@codereveals.com

---

## 2. Privacy & Security Architecture
InstantTool is architected with a strict privacy-first paradigm designed to eliminate third-party data vulnerability:
1. **Local Sandbox Execution**: PDF compression, PDF merging, video trimming, audio normalization, image format conversion, and code formatting execute completely within the client's browser environment utilizing WebAssembly compilations of trusted open-source libraries (including pdf-lib, ffmpeg.wasm, and browser canvas engines).
2. **Zero Retention Policy**: When server assistance is required (e.g. AI models, video extraction), files are transmitted exclusively over TLS 1.3 encrypted streams directly into transient RAM. No uploaded assets or generated outputs are saved, logged, or retained on persistent disk storage. All temporary artifacts are purged immediately upon stream completion.
3. **GDPR, CCPA & AdSense Compliance**: Full compliance with international privacy regulations. All third-party advertising utilizes Google AdSense and adheres to Google DART cookie standards with user-controllable opt-outs via Network Advertising Initiative (NAI) and AboutAds.

---

## 3. Directory of Available Tools & Technical Specs

### 3.1 PDF Suite
1. **Compress PDF** (`/pdf-tools/compress-pdf`)
   - Engine: WebAssembly PDF optimization
   - Input Formats: .pdf (Up to 500MB)
   - Function: Re-encodes embedded vector streams, flattens redundant font definitions, and compresses high-DPI raster assets.
   - Output: Reduced file size by up to 90% while maintaining crisp vector typography.

2. **Merge PDF** (`/pdf-tools/merge-pdf`)
   - Function: Joins 2 to 100 distinct PDF documents into a unified output file.
   - Features: Visual drag-and-drop page reordering, page deletion, and custom orientation.

3. **Split PDF** (`/pdf-tools/split-pdf`)
   - Function: Splits multi-page documents by single page ranges (e.g., "1-5, 8, 11-14") or extracts each page as an independent PDF archive.

4. **Sign PDF** (`/pdf-tools/sign-pdf`)
   - Function: In-browser canvas for drawing digital signatures, typing cryptographic signature stamps, or uploading transparent PNG signature assets.

5. **Rotate PDF** (`/pdf-tools/rotate-pdf`)
   - Function: Permanent 90°, 180°, or 270° clockwise rotation on individual pages or global documents.

6. **Protect & Unlock PDF** (`/pdf-tools/protect-pdf`, `/pdf-tools/unlock-pdf`)
   - Function: 128-bit and 256-bit AES encryption with password restriction for printing, editing, and copying.

---

### 3.2 Video Studio
1. **Trim Video** (`/video-tools/trim`)
   - Engine: In-browser HTML5 Video & Canvas keyframe extraction
   - Accuracy: Millisecond-level precision without quality loss or mandatory re-encoding.
   - Supported Containers: MP4, WebM, MOV, MKV, AVI.

2. **Crop Video** (`/video-tools/crop`)
   - Function: Aspect ratio transformation for social media reels (9:16 vertical), TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and standard 16:9 cinematic formats.

3. **Change Speed** (`/video-tools/speed`)
   - Range: 0.25x (smooth slow motion) to 4x (hyperlapse).

4. **Rotate & Flip Video** (`/video-tools/rotate`)
   - Function: Reorients flipped smartphone recordings and portrait/landscape misalignments.

5. **Downloaders** (`/video-tools/youtube-downloader`, `/video-tools/instagram-downloader`)
   - Function: High-speed extraction of public video streams with quality selector (1080p, 720p, 480p, MP3 audio).

---

### 3.3 Audio Studio
1. **Volume Booster** (`/audio-tools/volume`)
   - Engine: Web Audio API GainNode with dynamic compressor and true-peak limiter.
   - Range: Up to +200% volume amplification without acoustic clipping or harmonic distortion.

2. **Trim & Cut Audio** (`/audio-tools/trim`)
   - Visual: Interactive dynamic waveform display with millisecond cue selection.

3. **Audio Joiner** (`/audio-tools/joiner`)
   - Function: Seamless cross-track concatenation of podcast dialogue and musical stems.

4. **Audio Converter** (`/converters/audio`)
   - Formats: MP3, WAV, AAC, OGG, FLAC, M4A with customizable bitrate (128kbps, 192kbps, 320kbps).

---

### 3.4 SEO, AEO & GEO Suite
1. **Plagiarism Checker** (`/seo-tools/plagiarism-checker`)
   - Method: Statistical N-gram shingling and live index cross-examination across billions of online sources.
   - Output: Percentage of original content, duplicate sentence highlights, and source domain attribution.

2. **AEO & GEO Content Auditor** (`/seo-tools/geo-aeo-auditor`)
   - Purpose: Optimize text for citation within generative search engines (Perplexity AI, ChatGPT Search, Google Gemini AI Overviews).
   - Metrics: Direct Answerability Score, Entity Density, Quotability Index, and Structured Data Compliance.

3. **Meta Tag Generator** (`/seo-tools/meta-tag-generator`)
   - Output: Real-time interactive previews of Google Desktop/Mobile SERP snippets, OpenGraph image cards, and Twitter/X summary cards.

4. **AI Content Detector** (`/seo-tools/ai-detector`)
   - Method: Perplexity, entropy, and burstiness analysis across multi-engine baselines (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5, Gemini 1.5, DeepSeek).

5. **Schema Markup Generator** (`/seo-tools/schema-generator`)
   - Formats: Google-validated JSON-LD for Organization, WebSite, Article, FAQPage, HowTo, Product, and LocalBusiness.

---

### 3.5 AI Creation Suite
1. **Instant Background Remover** (`/ai-tools/remove-background`)
   - Method: Deep neural semantic segmentation isolating subjects with hair-level precision in ~0.8s.
   - Output: High-definition transparent PNG with alpha channel or custom solid color backdrops.

2. **AI Image Generator & Editor** (`/ai-tools/ai-image-generator`, `/ai-tools/ai-image-editor`)
   - Method: High-speed diffusion image generation from prompt descriptions with inpainting capabilities.

---
